newsitem.title: LATVIA: DAUGAVPILS CHAIN APPLIES FOR OFFICIAL LIST.
newsitem.headline: DAUGAVPILS CHAIN APPLIES FOR OFFICIAL LIST.

text.p: The Riga stock exchange said on Monday that Daugavpils chain factory submitted documents to be transferred to the exchange's official list on Friday.
"Daugavpils Chain factory on Friday submitted the necessary documents to be transferred to the official list," a bourse spokesman said.
The stock exchange now has 30 days to review the materials.
"We will not be in a rush," the spokesman said.
The securities commission in February announced the company's intention to join the official list.

Daugavpils Chain, a leading secondary list stock, earlier said it that sees a 1997 profit of 615,000 lats on turnover of 8.97 million lats against a 1996 profit of 1.064 million lats on turnover of 8.39 million lats.
Daugavpils had a first quarter pre-tax profit of 125,352 lats.
The company's shareholders earlier decided to use all of its 1996 profit for long-term investment but agreed pay 84 bonus shares per 100 held.
The registration day for those willing to receive the new shares is May 30.
On Monday's session Daugavpils shares fetched 2.40 lats, a fall of five santimes, in trade of 8,200 lats.
